COMMENT_default_location: Location served when a client doesn't specify one (GET /weather, or MQTT get_weather without lat/lon).
COMMENT_update_interval_minutes: How often every known location is refreshed from Open-Meteo.
COMMENT_dedup_radius_km: A request within this distance of a known location is served from it, instead of creating a new location.
COMMENT_max_known_locations: Beyond this, the least recently requested location is forgotten. The default location is never forgotten.
COMMENT_retry_base_secs: First retry delay after a failed fetch; doubles on each failure. Retries stop once the next one would land after the next periodic update.
